subject: J1-to-U2 connector-side routing channel

placement_semantics.condition: Only for a smaller isolated placement move that passes exact DRC, routability comparison, and the RAW USB plus VBUS critical probes.

notes: The first strategy connected all VBUS anchors but could not escape U2 pin 5 without colliding with pin 6 copper.
The distinct local-DP-reroute strategy restored D+ and escaped VBUS but crossed the preserved D- fanout.
The selected 0.4 mm offset is the minimum 0.1 mm-grid move that satisfies the reviewed two-channel geometry; the rejected 1.0 mm trial is not approved.
